name: marshal_paired_parameter_records
description: Reads two words from the caller's parameter block and copies each into a stack record, sending records through the dispatch table between writes. Stores a derived value back into the state block and emits a second record sequence from the same parameters.

name: exchange_pending_state_slot
description: Saves a pending value from the state block into a stack record, sends it through the dispatch table, then loads a replacement value through a helper into the same slot. Clears the slot after a second helper call.

name: marshal_parameter_pair_clear_slot
description: Copies two parameter words into stack records using a mode of two, sending each through the dispatch table. Loads a helper value into the pending state slot, clears that slot, and writes a marker record.

name: emit_marker_records_for_pair
description: Clears a pending state slot, copies two parameter words into stack records, and writes a marker record for each pair through the dispatch table. Uses a state-block value at a fixed offset as the second marker input.

name: clear_slots_set_table_bit
description: Zeroes two state slots addressed from parameters, calls a routine that returns a flag value, and ORs a bit into a table entry at a computed offset. Clears a further state word before returning.

name: clear_slot_set_table_bit
description: Zeroes one state slot addressed from a parameter, calls the same bit routine, and ORs a bit into the table entry at a computed offset. Clears a further state word before returning.

name: latch_selection_and_dispatch
description: Sets a state word to an all-ones sentinel, dispatches a record and a helper call, then latches a mode of one or two depending on whether the selection word is zero. Copies the latched value into its state slot and emits a marker record.

name: latch_selection_then_dispatch
description: Makes two helper calls, then stores a mode of one or two depending on whether the selection word is zero. Copies that mode into the latched state slot before emitting a marker record.

name: latch_selection_mode_record
description: Stores a mode of one or two depending on whether the selection word is zero, copies it into the latched state slot, and emits a marker record through the dispatch table.

name: emit_latched_value_record
description: Writes a mode of one and a marker record containing the latched state value, then sends the record through the dispatch table.

name: emit_latched_value_mode_two
description: Writes a mode of two and a marker record containing the latched state value, then sends the record through the dispatch table.

name: stub_bare_return_routine
description: The routine body is a bare return with no operations, so it does nothing when called.

name: dispatch_masked_record_update
description: Reads a value from the first parameter and a mask from the second, sends a record through the dispatch table, and when the masked bit is set emits a marker record from a state-derived value.

name: refresh_state_records_conditionally
description: Sends a state-derived record and a second record through the dispatch table, then emits a marker record only if the low word of a parameter is non-zero. Stores the latest state value back into the block.

name: emit_parameter_record_sequence
description: Copies a parameter word and several state values into stack records, sends a record through the dispatch table, then writes a marker record and a state update through the helper routines.

name: emit_parameter_record_pair
description: Copies a parameter word and a state value into stack records and sends a short sequence of records through the dispatch table. Writes a marker into a stack-allocated word at the end.

name: build_marker_record_chain
description: Builds a longer chain of marker records from parameter words and state values, sending each record through the dispatch table and writing a marker into each stack-allocated slot.

name: write_marker_record_with_count
description: Writes a marker record and a count of ten into stack records, then sends the record through the dispatch table together with a state-derived value.

name: emit_state_value_record_short
description: Writes a mode of one and a marker record with the latched state value, then sends the record through a dispatch helper. Shorter variant of the latched value emitter.

name: stub_bare_return_routine
description: The routine body is a bare return with no operations, so it does nothing when called.

name: emit_selection_records_after_probe
description: Passes a value to one helper before latching the selection word into two records, with a mode of one or two chosen by a branch on the selection's low word. Writes marker records to state slots and ends with a shared emitter call and the state-block callback.

name: emit_mode_one_selection_pair
description: Emits a mode-one record and a mode-two record from the selection word, with a branch on its low word that calls two helpers on either path. Writes marker records into state slots, emits a final record pair through the shared emitter, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_mode_two_selection_pair
description: Starts with a mode-two record and marker from the selection word, then runs the same branch and helper calls as its siblings. Emits a final record pair through the shared emitter and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_selection_pair_helper_callback
description: Emits a mode-one and mode-two record from the selection word, with a branch that calls two helpers, writes marker records into state slots, and sends a record pair to the shared emitter. Ends by invoking the state-block callback.

name: emit_selection_marker_pair_short

name: emit_selection_marker_after_helpers

name: latch_selection_pair_and_callback

name: write_marker_pair_and_callback

name: emit_selection_records_routine_refs

name: emit_selection_mode_two_alt

name: emit_latched_selection_pair_short

description: Calls a shared routine, emits a pair of values from state slots through the shared emitter, writes a status marker, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: write_status_marker_and_callback
description: Writes a status marker into a state slot, emits a state value through a helper, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_status_record_table_entry
description: Emits status records built from a table entry indexed by a state word, using helper calls and a fixed marker, then invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_status_records_state_pair
description: Emits status records from a pair of state slots, using a table entry indexed by a state word, helper calls and a status marker, before invoking the state-block callback.

name: emit_marker_then_dual_callbacks
description: Writes a status marker, invokes a second function pointer, and then invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_status_value_then_callback
description: Emits a status value through a helper call and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_marker_then_dual_callbacks
description: Writes a status marker, invokes a second function pointer, and then invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_alt_status_pair_callback
description: Clears a flag word, emits a pair of alternate status markers through the shared emitter, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_flag_value_then_callback
description: Emits a flag value through a helper and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_table_indexed_status_records
description: Emits a long run of status records looked up from table entries indexed by a state word, with helper calls between records, then invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_marker_record_offset_callback
description: Writes a marker record at a state-table offset from a helper result, emits a status constant through helpers, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_offset_marker_then_callback
description: Writes a status marker record at a state-table offset through a helper, passes a state value to the shared routine, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_status_records_partial_decode
description: Writes status constants and records through helper calls and a shared routine. The listing ends in undecodable data, so the behaviour after the last helper call is unknown.

name: emit_status_pair_shared_routine
description: Writes two status words, passes stack-built arguments to the shared routine, stores a state value into a slot, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_table_status_records_refs
description: Calls shared routines on a state slot, looks up a table entry indexed by a status word, emits records through helper calls, and stores a derived value into a status word.

name: emit_status_records_offset_helper
description: Emits records built from a state value and table offsets through helper calls, writing a status constant and passing the records to the shared routine.

name: emit_status_records_multi_helper
description: Emits a longer set of status and offset records using a value from the status table, helper calls and the shared routine.

name: emit_flag_marker_and_callback
description: Sets a flag marker, emits a record through helper calls and a shared routine, clears a flag word, and invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_table_status_records_tail
description: Looks up a table entry from a status word, writes derived constants and records through the helpers and shared routine, then invokes the state-block callback.

name: emit_status_record_with_offsets
description: Emits status records at table offsets derived from a state word, passing each through helper calls and the shared emitter.

name: emit_status_marker_pair_return
description: Writes a status marker and a secondary marker through the shared emitter and returns.

name: stub_bare_return_routine
description: The routine body is a bare return with no operations, so it does nothing when called.

name: emit_status_marker_pairs_loop
description: Writes status marker pairs, then loops over a table of status-word entries, calling helper routines on each entry.

name: emit_table_loop_until_flag
description: Writes a status marker pair, then loops over table entries indexed by a counter, calling helper routines and storing each entry until a flag word is non-zero, then stores the final counter.

name: emit_table_loop_flag_short
description: Writes a status marker pair and loops over table entries indexed by a counter, storing each entry until a flag word is non-zero, then stores the final counter.

name: emit_table_loop_remaining_entries
description: Continues the table loop by calling a helper on each entry, storing each one on the stack, and stopping when the flag word is non-zero.

name: store_loop_counter_result
description: Stores the loop counter into a result word and returns.

name: emit_table_loop_body
description: Loop body that looks up the table entry for the current counter, writes it to the stack, and repeats until the flag word is non-zero.

name: store_loop_counter_result
description: Stores the loop counter into a result word and returns.
